prs.title: Simple path — summary + diagrams
prs.summary:
One or two tight paragraphs. Markdown supported: **bold**, `code`, - bullets, ## sub-headings.

Say *what changed and why*, not a line-by-line retelling of the diff.

diagrams.title: Or Mermaid (needs internet)
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[start] --> B{decision}
  B -- yes --> C[do thing]
  B -- no --> D[skip]

review.global: Overall assessment. Add this only in **LM-analysis or deep-audit mode**; omit it from a workspace spec.
